answer_1.quote: We introduce DISJOINT-3DQA 1 , a generative QA benchmark

answer_2.quote: we adopt the LLM-Match metric proposed by OpenEQA to evaluate model predictions

answer_3.quote: employ a large language model to rate the semantic similarity between predicted and reference answers on a 1-5 scale

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample a subset of 600 questions for estimating human performance on DISJOINT-3DQA. Three human evaluators independently answer each question
